title: A forward-start swap with state-dependent annuity
prompt: All figures and markets in this question are synthetic. At time1 a forward-start swap has value N*A*(K-R) to a receiver of fixed. The two time1 states have the supplied pricing probabilities. The time0-to1 discount factor is deterministic. A is the time1 discounted fixed-leg annuity in years; R is that state's par rate. Return the zero-value receiver strike, arithmetic expected rate, and time0 receiver PV if struck at the arithmetic expected rate.

outputs.name: fair_strike
outputs.description: Strike making expected discounted swap PV zero.

outputs.name: receiver_pv_at_arithmetic_rate
outputs.description: PV when K equals the arithmetic expected R.
